sql: SELECT TOP 10 c.Code AS couponCode, p.Discount AS discountAmount, p.PromoCode AS promoCode FROM dbo.ZnodePromotion p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePromotionCoupon c ON c.PromotionId = p.PromotionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePromotionType t ON t.PromotionTypeId = p.PromotionTypeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal s ON s.PortalId = p.PortalId WHERE t.Name = @promotionTypeName AND p.StartDate <= @now AND p.EndDate >= @now AND c.IsActive = @couponActive AND c.AvailableQuantity >= @redemptionsNeeded AND s.StoreCode = @store AND p.Discount = @discountAmount AND p.IsCouponRequired = @couponRequired AND p.OrderMinimum <= @maxOrderMinimum AND p.PromotionMessage = @promotionMessage AND p.PromoCode NOT LIKE @tdaPromoCodePattern AND (@preferred IS NULL OR c.Code = @preferred) ORDER BY c.PromotionCouponId
